text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон has been feeling off her
game
lately, so she asks me to go to a
shrine with her.
choice_data_list: I didn't take you as the type to pray for favors.

text_block_list.text:
What? No, I'm not here for that. It's not
like
praying will miraculously cure me.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I should be looking after my health,
that's a
given. I'm just tryin' to keep my
spirits high.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
See, I'm gonna make a promise to the
gods.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
A promise that I'll accomplish things with
my own
power and without any divine
intervention
needed.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna promise them that I won't go
anywhere
when the going gets tough,
and that I'll train
harder than anyone
else and come out on top!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I can't turn my back on a promise to the
gods,
right?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: Then I promise to help you win, no matter what.

text_block_list.text: All right, let's get to prayin', then.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Clang, clang! Clap, clap!

Hey, you'd better keep your eyes on me
up there,
'cause I'm gonna leave all my
opponents in the
dust, no matter how
tough they are!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Phew. Guess this'll have to do. I'm
feeling better
already... Huh?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Rustle, rustle...

I was wondering what all the ruckus was
about...
Figures it'd be you, Ama.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Brian? What're you doing here?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Nothing. Just some solo training.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Anyway, later.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Solo training, huh?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
What am I doing, goofin' around when
Brian's out
here runnin' and trainin' so
hard?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
But y'know what? Seeing her has really
pulled me
out of my funk! I'm startin' to
feel like myself
again! Let's run back
home, full speed!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Maybe me meetin' Brian was a little
nudge from
above!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Meeeow.
text_block_list.name: Cat

text_block_list.text: Oh, it's just a cat. Aren't you a cute li'l—
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Mrraaow!
text_block_list.name: Cat

text_block_list.text: Hey, that's my handkerchief!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Come back here!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... What the heck... You're tellin' me I can't even catch a cat now?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Looks like Хиши Амадзон is back to her
normal,
energetic self!

Хиши Амадзон's poor health leaves her at
the cat's
mercy...
